title: Course
description: Canonical shape of a course. The single contract shared by frontend, backend and agent. Change only via reviewed PR. NOTE: the deeper Course→Module→Lesson→Unit hierarchy and full evaluation model from the spec are documented in CLAUDE.md as the target; the POC implements Course→Module with a seed quiz.

profile.description: Target end-user profile. Visibility axis: a published course is visible only to end-users of this profile.

level.description: Content depth chosen at generation time (optional metadata).

status.description: Lifecycle. Generated courses start as 'draft'. Only an explicit admin approval moves draft→approved→published. End-users see ONLY 'published'. This is the mandatory human-in-the-loop gate.

quiz.description: Seed of the spec's evaluation model. Future: typed questions (multiple-choice / true-false / scenario), attempts, pass threshold — see CLAUDE.md.
